# `approx_top_k_estimate`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns top k items with their frequency.
`k` An optional INTEGER literal greater than 0. If k is not specified, it defaults to 5.

**Applies to:** not available in Krishiv yet. Spark: 4.1 and later.

## Syntax

```text
approx_top_k_estimate(state, k)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Not implemented yet |
| Group | `sketch_funcs` |
| Kind | aggregate (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.1.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.1 and later |
| Arguments | [1, 2] |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- approx_top_k_estimate, example 1
> SELECT approx_top_k_estimate(approx_top_k_accumulate(expr)) FROM VALUES (0), (0), (1), (1), (2), (3), (4), (4) AS tab(expr);
Error: KRISHIV_UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE
```

```sql
-- approx_top_k_estimate, example 2
> SELECT approx_top_k_estimate(approx_top_k_accumulate(expr), 2) FROM VALUES 'a', 'b', 'c', 'c', 'c', 'c', 'd', 'd' tab(expr);
Error: KRISHIV_UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 4.1.0.
